issues.title: Missing testTags on interactive UI components
issues.description: 10 interactive components (Buttons, Clickables) are declared without explicit 'testTag' identifiers. This interferes with downstream Roborazzi and Robolectric automation suites.
issues.cause: Omission of modifier.testTag() properties during rapid prototyping.
issues.impact: Prevents automated GUI scanning and visual regression tests from reliably locating targets.

issues.title: Hardcoded Hex Color designations in presentation layers
issues.description: Found hardcoded Hex color declarations in feature screens like feature-debug/src/main/java/com/example/feature/debug/ui/DebugScreen.kt. This bypasses Wear Core's global design theme system.
issues.cause: Direct instancing of Color(0x...) in local composables.
issues.impact: Breaks cohesive light/dark color transitions, leading to unreadable contrast ratios on physical watches.

issues.title: Dangling modules missing formal Contracts declarations
issues.description: Feature modules [feature-debug, feature-drawer, feature-launcher, feature-media, feature-notifications, feature-sensors, feature-settings] have not declared a clear feature Contract containing routes, event logs, or permission mandates.
issues.cause: New modules added without initializing formal contracts structures.
issues.impact: Makes module behavior completely untraceable for other features, as well as AI diagnostic crawlers.

corrections.suggestedCorrection: Append Moderator.testTag("tag_name") to all interactive components in presentation routes.
corrections.benefitExpected: 100% stable integration tests and simplified end-to-end user navigation flows on virtual streams.

corrections.suggestedCorrection: Reference ColorScheme tokens like MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary or custom CoreUi theme guidelines.
corrections.benefitExpected: Cohesive systemic dark mode theme alignments across foldables, watch face simulations, and high-density circular panels.

corrections.suggestedCorrection: Configure a centralized Contract file for each flagged feature mapped to core routing specifications.
corrections.benefitExpected: Guarantees 100% observability, allowing human developers and AI crawlers to scan component APIs dynamically.

ux.title: Watch face swipe interactions simulation
ux.description: Provide interactive click-swipe visual loops inside the Quick Settings and App Drawer tabs to let users preview physical watch haptic gestures.
ux.benefit: Immersive hardware previewing on conventional desktop viewports.

ux.title: Pre-empt watch-disconnect state prompts
ux.description: Show immediate visual alerts if Bluetooth state simulation inside Debug Center is set to OFF to clearly alert the developer.
ux.benefit: Averts confusing silent state failures, speeding up local feature testing.

ui.title: Visual Radial Padding Guide and Safe-Zone overlay
ui.description: Add an optional transparent overlay representing a watch bezel (372px circular watch face) to allow real-time layout boundary checking.
ui.benefit: Instantly flags cut-off buttons and text labels hugging physical screen edges.

ui.title: Contrast accessibility indicators
ui.description: Display an automatically calculated WCAG contrast rating label right next to hardcoded colors in the widgets view.
ui.benefit: Ensures legal contrast targets on physical watch displays under direct outdoor sunlight.

documentation.title: Generate physical memory maps per watch feature
documentation.description: Compile and preserve a detailed, dynamic watch RAM ceiling sheet inside ROADMAP.md based on scanned source files and database size models.
documentation.benefit: Sets strict boundaries to ensure the application stays under physical memory thresholds on 1GB RAM watches.

architecture.title: State restoration verification flow
architecture.description: Establish a mock process restoration UseCase inside ':feature-debug' to check if state restoration safely handles spontaneous Watch OS task pruning.
architecture.benefit: Robust recovery from system background memory purges on older Android 8 machines.

performance.title: LazyColumn content drawing validations
performance.description: Implement recomposition trackers and compile-time warnings on items lacking distinct stable keys inside TransformingLazyColumn layouts.
performance.benefit: Brings lists down to perfect sub-millisecond drawing speeds on watch microchips.

history.title: Log file modification hash certificates
history.description: Include a verified sha256 checksum next to every file level history modification event to prevent telemetry spoofing.
history.benefit: Guarantees 100% secure, immutable blockchain-ready audit history trails.

exportation.title: Expose system-wide insights schema to JSON downloads
exportation.description: Integrate the audit reports directly inside 'wear-core-state-export.json' to allow immediate multi-factor cognitive scans by remote AI systems.
exportation.benefit: Zero-effort remote diagnostic loading, letting an incoming AI learn of codebase errors in 1ms.

aiFriendly.title: Inject contextual documentation prompts right in JSON schemas
aiFriendly.description: Introduce custom '_llm_guidelines' properties in state payloads explaining the precise architecture parameters to bypass training data limits.
aiFriendly.benefit: Guarantees highly reliable prompt alignment and clean context matching during long multi-turn sessions.

suggestedKpis.name: Accessibility Compliance Ratio
suggestedKpis.reason: Shows ratio of UI screens having complete and accessible test tags for automated screenreaders.

suggestedKpis.name: Modular Isolation Integrity
suggestedKpis.reason: Measures cross-dependency violations inside build.gradle.kts to locate illicit feature crossovers.

suggestedKpis.name: Continuous Documented Index Ratio
suggestedKpis.reason: Validates that every single compiled code file has been documented with an AI-friendly purpose summary.
